purpose: Functional reference only; not A9 timing
configuration:
[sdl]
output=surface
[dosbox]
memsize=2
machine=vgaonly
[cpu]
core=normal
cputype=386
cycles=fixed 3000
[mixer]
nosound=true
[sblaster]
sbtype=none
[autoexec]
mount c "<workspace>/.context/amiga/dosbox-x-review/drive"
c:
filetest > file.log
exetest > exe.log
ver > version.txt
exit
